title: slack_post
description: Input schema for the fleet demo's external `slack_post` tool (ARCH §3.3 tool triple). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

text.description: The message body to append to the shared channel. It is posted under the fleet's human account and the client's agent marker is appended to it, so write it as something a human peer reading the channel should see. Sign it on its own final line with the coordinator persona.
